            text = res.stdout
            if '"Complete"' in text:

        cs = item.get("status", {}).get("containerStatuses", [])

        raise RuntimeError("No completed job times found")

        try:

            ts_start = float(parts[-2])
            ts_end = float(parts[-1])

    violations = [s for s in near_target if s["p95_ms"] > 1.0]
    return {
